reapack.desc: Munder Difflin office tools (Reception, Shredder, Stapler, Copier, Binder)

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0 \fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20 {\b\fs28 Munder Difflin}\par Small, office-themed tools for sound design in REAPER.\par \par - Reception: the front desk. Dial 1-4 to open a tool, 5-9 for custom dials, 0 for the operator.\par - Shredder: grinds selected audio into randomized, automated fragments.\par - Stapler: lines up the first transient of every layer, with an offset.\par - Copier: turns audio into MIDI (ALL, CHORDS, MELODY, BASS, HITS).\par - Binder: files track templates, FX chains and audio; drag them onto tracks.\par - Munder Difflin: the business card. Credits, orientation and shared settings.\par \par Tip: bind Reception to a key. When REAPER asks about the already running instance,\par choose "Terminate instances" + "Remember" and the same key opens/closes it.\par }
